Physical layer failure on the WAN serial interface (cable/carrier loss) is taking down the only path to HQ.

Co-channel interference from AP1 and AP2 both using channel 6 with full power in overlapping coverage areas.

Route redistribution misconfiguration is creating a routing loop for the default route between R1 and R2.
